rationale: Open the faulted branch l23 to isolate the b2-b3 section. Close the normally-open tie_24 (b2-b4) to re-energize b4 and, via l34, b3 from the source. Remaining closed branches l_s1, l12, l34, tie_24 form a connected radial tree, so all load buses b2 (priority 3), b3 (priority 5), and b4 (priority 2) are restored, giving priority_restored = 10 (meets min_priority_restored) and restored_load_kw = 170 with 2 switching actions.
